app.buildCommand: if [ "$VERCEL_ENV" = "preview" ]; then VITE_DEMO_MODE=true npm run build -- --mode demo; else npm run release:check -- --frontend && npm run build; fi

api.buildCommand: node --check server.js && if [ "$VERCEL_ENV" = "production" ]; then npm run release:check; fi

headers.value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' https://static.line-scdn.net https://apis.google.com; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob: https:; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' https://*.googleapis.com https://*.firebaseio.com wss://*.firebaseio.com https://*.line.me https://*.line-scdn.net https://*.line-apps.com; frame-src https://*.firebaseapp.com https://access.line.me; worker-src 'self' blob:; frame-ancestors 'none'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'
